description: Department of Elections - Vacating the Office of member of Udapalatha Pradeshiya Sabha by Mr. Periyasamy Mailvaganam - vacating the office of member of Mahawa Pradehiya Sabha by Mr. Aruna Bandara Imihami Mudiyanselage
categorisation: This gazette contains notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific members have vacated their offices in Pradeshiya Sabhas (local government bodies) due to ceasing membership in their respective political parties. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, falling under the Elections category (Type 7) which covers electoral matters including declarations about candidate status and office vacancies.
